Far-right extremism surfaces in German football, NYT reports

Far-right extremism has infiltrated German football, with reports detailing threats and intimidation tactics used by extremist groups. The New York Times documented instances where individuals displaying far-right symbols, such as the Nazi flag, were met with violent threats. One account describes a warning: 'If we see that flag again, we’ll shoot you.' These incidents highlight a growing concern about the presence of extremist ideologies within the sport in Germany.
